descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Our team is building an integration framework to be able to deliver content and features to customers using self-service within Cegeka, driving standardization and automation.
 Our integration team is looking for a Python developer to help us create/maintain the integrations between our customer helpdesk platforms/CMBD with our own custom support platforms.
 You will be working in multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud) and the Cegeka data centers using SCRUM and Agile development.
 Your day-to-day: 
Develop web integrations and standalone scripts to support the processes and automation of the internal organization and external customers in an existing team of developers
Design and develop new features
Maintain and improve functionality on our existing software products
Support the technical and analyst team
Play an important role in the technical analysis of the software that will be developed (the delivered software is often highly technical in nature and will mostly be used internally by our colleague engineers)
 What you bring to the team: 
4+ years of in-depth experience with Python and Django (including Django REST Framework), developing robust web applications and APIs. (Flask and FastAPI frameworks are a plus)
Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL)
Thorough knowledge of REST API, JSON, and XML data formats, GIT version control
Experience with SQL syntax and queries, network protocols (TCP/IP)
Familiarity with microservices architectures, CQRS, Event-Driven Design, and message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Practical experience with Agile methodology and JIRA
Basic knowledge of Docker
 Nice to have: 
Experience with other scripting languages (such as Javascript, PHP or Ruby) is a plus
Exposure to tools like Splunk, Sentry, New Relic, Prometheus, or Grafana
Affinity and interest in systems. Technologies like Linux, webservers (NGINX, Apache, IIS…), etc.
Administration of PostgreSQL and/or MySQL
Basic knowledge of OpenShift and ArgoCD
